# Berkeley Earth temperature data

Upstream source record for historical land-temperature files used by `Medium-Blog/clima_portugal`.

## Source

- Publisher: Berkeley Earth
- Data page: https://berkeleyearth.org/data/
- Current general licence: CC BY-NC 4.0

The Medium repository contains historical CSV snapshots named:

- `GlobalTemperatures.csv`
- `GlobalLandTemperaturesByCountry.csv`
- `GlobalLandTemperaturesByState.csv`
- `GlobalLandTemperaturesByMajorCity.csv`

Their exact historical download lineage is not documented sufficiently to promote those LFS objects into the canonical repository. The snapshots remain with the article; this record points future work to the authoritative publisher.
